
The `get_or_set` method (line 13) handles expiry by comparing `time.monotonic() - hit[1]` (age of cached entry) against `self.ttl_seconds`. If the entry is still fresh (`age < ttl`), it returns the cached value; otherwise it falls through to `producer()` to recompute and cache a new value with the current timestamp (line 20).

The `_entries` dict stores tuples of `(value, timestamp)` — line 20 sets the entry, line 16 captures `now` for the comparison.
